pageDescriptions.balance-sheet: Financial position at a point in time: assets, liabilities, and equity.
pageDescriptions.cash-flow: Cash movements grouped into operating, investing, and financing activities.
pageDescriptions.comparative: Compare revenue, expense, and net income across fiscal years.
pageDescriptions.income-statement: Revenue and expenses over a period to show net income.
pageDescriptions.trial-balance: Debit and credit totals of every account to check that the books balance.
pageDescriptions.trial-balance-detailed: Trial balance with opening, movement, and closing balance per account.
pageDescriptions.general-ledger: Every journal line posted to an account within a period, with running balance.
pageDescriptions.budget-variance: Compare actual spending against the approved budget per account.
pageDescriptions.customer-statement: Transaction history and outstanding balance for one customer.
pageDescriptions.ar-aging: Receivables grouped by age bucket to show overdue customer balances.
pageDescriptions.ar-outstanding: Open customer invoices that still have an unpaid balance.
pageDescriptions.ap-aging: Payables grouped by age bucket to show overdue supplier balances.
pageDescriptions.ap-outstanding: Open supplier bills that still have an unpaid balance.
pageDescriptions.ap-payment-history: Payments made to suppliers within the selected period.
pageDescriptions.assets-register: Fixed asset list with acquisition, location, and current status.
pageDescriptions.book-value-depreciation: Acquisition cost, accumulated depreciation, and book value per asset.
pageDescriptions.maintenance-cost: Maintenance spending per asset over the selected period.
pageDescriptions.asset-stocktake-variances: Differences between recorded and physically counted assets.
pageDescriptions.inventory-valuation: Stock quantity and value per product and warehouse.
pageDescriptions.inventory-stocktake-variance: Differences between system stock and physical stocktake counts.
pageDescriptions.purchase-history: Purchase transactions with supplier and product detail.
pageDescriptions.purchase-order-status: Progress of purchase orders from issue to receipt and billing.
pageDescriptions.stock-movement: Stock in and out per product, with source document.
pageDescriptions.stock-adjustment: Stock adjustments that changed quantities, with reason.
pageDescriptions.goods-receipt: Goods received from suppliers against purchase orders.
pageDescriptions.approval-audit-trail: History of approval actions taken on requests.
pageDescriptions.pipeline-audit-trail: History of state transitions on pipeline records.
